Harry Potter.effect: Once per turn, when you play your second card, draw 1 card.

Ron Weasley.effect: When you play an Ally, it costs 1 Action instead of 2.

Hermione Granger.effect: Once per turn, when you play your second spell, draw 1 Lesson.

Luna Lovegood.effect: Once per turn, if you control 6 or more Lessons, you may discard 2 Lessons to create a Thestral Token.

Aquamenti.effect: Deal 2 damage to a Creature or player.

Flipendo.effect: Return a Creature with a Cost of 3 or less to its owner's hand.

Stupefy.effect: Deal 2 damage to a Creature or Player. If your opponent controls exactly one Creature, deal 2 additional damage to that Creature or the player.

Episkey.effect: Restore 4 Health to a Creature or Player.

Expelliarmus.effect: Deal 2 damage to a Player. Additional Cost — Discard 1 Lesson: Destroy an Ongoing Spell or an Item.

Priori Incantatem.effect: Discard a card from your hand. Return a Spell from your discard pile to your hand.

Atmospheric Charm.effect: Each Player shuffles their hand into their deck, then draws 4 cards.

Reducto.effect: Deal 1 damage to your opponent, plus 1 additional damage for each damage they have taken.

Wildfire Whiz Bangs.effect: Deal 7 damage to a Creature or Player.

Apparate.effect: Choose one: Destroy a Location; or destroy a Spell targeting you.

Avis.effect: Additional Cost — Discard 1 Transfiguration Lesson: Create 3 Bird Tokens.

Confundus.effect: Look at your opponent's hand. Choose a Spell there. That Spell cannot be played this turn.

Incarcerous.effect: The next Spell you play this turn that targets an opponent's card affects all valid targets controlled by that opponent instead of one.

Bat Bogey Hex.effect: Destroy a Spell with a Cost of 4 or less. If you do, draw a card.

Oppugno.effect: Countdown 2: Deal 1 damage to a Player, plus 1 additional damage for every 2 Creatures you control.

Petrificus Totalus.effect: Choose one: Destroy an ally; or freeze a creature.

Carpe Retractum.effect: Return up to 2 items you control to your hand.

Pawn.effect: When this is destroyed: draw 1 card.

Bowtruckle.effect: When this enters play: look at the top 3 cards of your deck. You may reveal an Item among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom.

Mooncalf.effect: The first time you play a Lesson each turn: Mooncalf gets +1 Damage until end of turn.

Niffler.effect: Niffler counts as a Lesson while in play.

Pixies.effect: When this enters play: if you control another Creature, draw 1 card.

Snowman.effect: When this deals damage to a Player, Freeze an opposing Creature.

Firecrab.effect: Block (You must deal damage to me first).

Monster Book.effect: When this enters play: return a Spell with Cost 3 or less from your discard pile to your hand.

Flying Broom.effect: When this enters play, choose one: Draw 1 card or Discard a card to Draw a lesson.

Golden Snitch.effect: When this enters play or is returned to its owner's hand, you may draw 1 card.

Golden Snidget.effect: Whenever this deals damage to a Player, draw a card.

Bludger.effect: When this enters play or is returned to its owner's hand, deal 2 damage to a target.

Quidditch Kit.effect: The first time you play a Quidditch card each turn, look at the top 2 cards of your deck. Put one into your hand and the other on the bottom.

Winged Catapult.effect: Whenever this deals damage to a Player, look at the top card of your deck. You may put it on the bottom.

Beater.effect: Once per turn, you may discard a card: Return a Quidditch Item to its owner's hand.

Seeker.effect: Once per turn, search your deck for a Golden Snitch or Quidditch Item, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.

Guardian.effect: When damage would be dealt to you or a Quidditch Creature you control, discard me to prevent that damage.

Memory Vial.effect: Once per turn, you may discard a card from your hand to draw a Lesson.

Weasley Firework Box.effect: All the creatures your control deal 1 aditional damage.
